svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: two posts 1400 long and two cross members 1270 long of angle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mitred, welded into a rectangle 1320 x 1400 (outside).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One leg lies flat toward the pit; the other leg points back to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tower so the frame bolts to the front tower plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sheet: 4 PP 1270 x 1140 with a 52 hole for the jackshaft,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre 60 right of the left edge of the sheet and 115 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the sheet 8 at 200 pitch round its edge, frame 6.5; M6 A4

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with large washers (PP moves with heat).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: posts bolt to the front rail; the frame to the tower plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no gap over 10 mm round the jackshaft or along the posts.
